notes.title: Patch Notes 11.07.2024
notes.content:
Major changes:

- Added english and german subtitles

- Added english menu support

- Added guided mode

Bugfixes: 

- Level 2.2: Changed mushroom eat count to always 3

- Level 2.2: Mushrooms now also get spawned if you enter through menu

- Level 3.7: Hands are shown now

Usability:

- Held objects can no longer be dropped

- Added cues for eating the mushrooms, grabbing the torch and the knife
